          timeoutSeconds: 1

              fieldPath: metadata.name
        - name: POD_NAMESPACE
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: metadata.namespace
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80

        - containerPort: 443

        - /nginx-ingress-controller
